#BigDaddyHurt.Face.bdhNormal
Who is this dude?! He’s as black as night and almost 7 feet tall! 
I thought some nerdy white dude would come. He doesn’t look like someone who needs to use sexbot at all. 
Girls must be all over his ass.
On the other hand… {{wi}}no wonder he likes sexbots, they for sure have more durability than real women. 
Good God, just looking at the size of this man is making me scared.
You: H-hi… Are you... hm, bigdaddyhurt1177?
This cringe name was harder to say at loud than I thought...
bigdaddyhurt1177: In person, little one. Don’t be shy buddy.
You: I-I’m not really… shy…{{wi}} I think.
bigdaddyhurt1177: Don’t worry, I don’t bite!
You: Y-yeah…
You: Thanks for help with the website that is selling parts for bots.
bigdaddyhurt1177: No biggie, I’m always trying to help people in da sexbot community. 
You: Cool.
bigdaddyhurt1177: Is it everything you wanted to tell me?
You: N-no, I wanted to ask you about my problem.
You: You see, I have many bot parts in my room and it really is becoming a bother. Do you know how I could get rid of them?
bigdaddyhurt1177: There isn’t much of a demand for them right now, so sellin is not possible.
You: Oh.
bigdaddyhurt1177: If you have no space left you can always give them to I. I have lots of free spaces in my house.
You: That’s great! Thanks!
bigdaddyhurt1177: No problem, it’s a good deal for me. I’m something of a collector.
You: Nice.
You: So, how should I give them to you?
bigdaddyhurt1177: You can just throw them like other things and my men will come to pick it up.
His…{{wi}} men?
You: O-ok…
bigdaddyhurt1177: All right little one, it was a pleasure to meet you in da person, but I gotta go home. My wife is probably worried sick that I’m not home at such an hour.
You: Y-you have a wife?
bigdaddyhurt1177: Of course I do! Why de confusion?
Oh shit, I said it out loud, I hope he’s not mad at me...
You: N-no it’s nothing...{{wi}} it’s just…{{wi}} you know…{{wi}} I just can’t imagine how a sexbot collector can be a family man.
bigdaddyhurt1177: It isn’t easy to find the right woman, but as my friend would always tell me: ‘we all gonna make it someday’.
…
bigdaddyhurt1177: My girl was a bit shocked about my hobby, but I convinced her, if you know what I mean! Haha!
I have no idea what he's talking about.
You: Yeah, of course I get it. h-he-he…
bigdaddyhurt1177: See ya next time!
